scope: Private web beta settings discovery, fresh defaults and exact plan locks

approvedBehavior.discovery: Three finite pulses, then persistent highlight until the header Settings button is opened. Per account and browser. Reduced motion uses a static highlight.
approvedBehavior.freshDefaults: Hashtags and permitted emojis on; long description, bullets and Standard tone; seller note excluded.
approvedBehavior.lockedOptions: Locks next to each unavailable tone, emoji switch and seller note inclusion. Activation opens pricing in a separate tab without changing the draft or starting checkout.
approvedBehavior.savedChoices: Existing defaults and drafts retain their choices. Plan restrictions affect displayed controls and new generation inputs, not stored preferences or uncertain retry inputs.

deployment.verified: Short link returns 307 to the existing protected branch alias. Protected app returns 200 with the new lock markup and discovery bundle; anonymous access redirects to Vercel login. Pricing returns 200. Project-wide preview skip and Vercel protection remain unchanged. Public production app remains disabled.

verification.redTest: The focused rendered-browser test first failed because a new account had no Settings discovery cue.
verification.focusedBrowser: 5 scenarios passed: global/item/batch defaults and generation payloads; Basic locks and keyboard pricing navigation; saved opt-outs and reduced motion; account isolation and downgrade/upgrade preferences; Free extras and responsive widths.
verification.existingBrowserJourney: 16 checks passed, including ten local photos, long descriptions, stable Generate/Mark as listed actions, batch generation, local reload and offline persistence, exact deletion preview, selection, limits, dropdowns, account sheet and lost-response recovery.
verification.releaseGate: Lint, TypeScript, Astro build, formatting and all 864 tests in 121 files passed with RUN_GENERATION_BROWSER_TESTS=1. The real browser/HTTP retry integration tests ran.
verification.visual: Inspected Settings highlight and locked tone dropdown screenshots at 360px. No horizontal overflow at 360, 390, 768 or 1440px. Header bounds remain identical after discovery clears.
verification.limitations: External auth, usage, upload and generation services are fixtures in the UI tests. No customer generation or checkout was executed. Physical iOS/Android camera, keyboard and storage behavior was not reverified for this change.

cleanup: The test server was stopped and the generation inspection helper removed. Automatic approval review blocked deletion of /tmp/autolister-settings-qa and /tmp/autolister-settings-flow-qa. These task-owned screenshots and browser outputs remain locally; no customer data or secrets are stored in them.
